name: SQ4D ARCS 4.2
summary: Ruggedized gantry 3D concrete printer (Autonomous Robotic Construction System) from New York that prints footings, foundation walls, slabs and walls of full-size houses on site; the new ARCS is offered for sale.

germany.statusNote: Offered for sale only in the USA ('Reserve ARCS 4.2 Now'); the enquiry form asks for a US state. No German or EU route or CE information found.

specs.label: Frame material
specs.quote: The printer is built from aircraft-grade aluminum and stainless steel; the machine is built to last.

specs.label: Power draw
specs.value: about the current of a standard hair dryer
specs.quote: The current used on our ARCS 3D Printer is about the same as a standard hairdryer.

notes: Gantry-style printer set up over the building footprint on site.
Also prints footings, slab and insulation inside the walls with a proprietary nozzle (maker project pages).

evidence.task: Printed on site the first permitted 3D-printed house for sale in the USA (3 bedrooms, about 1,400 sq ft)
evidence.note: Listed for sale for $299,999 and slated to receive a certificate of occupancy.

evidence.task: Printed foundation, footings, slab, walls and insulation of a 1,629 sq ft Habitat for Humanity home (over 50 % of the structure printed)

sources.title: First permitted 3D printed house for sale (Riverhead, NY)
World's first predominantly 3D printed house (Islip, NY)
